source_title: Iran war live: Araghchi says talks under way on 2-day plan to reopen Hormuz
source_excerpt: ‘Epic resilience’ by Iran’s military has brought the US and allies to the ‘hard wall of reality’ over the conflict, official says. US President Donald Trump says negotiations with Iran are “going fine” but claims that he’s “not in that much of a hurry” to make a peace deal. Iran warns it can inflict “devastating strikes” on US warships in the Middle East and says enemy forces attempting a ground invasion will face a “killing ground”. US President Donald Trump says negotiations with Iran are “going fine” but claims that he’s “not in that much of a hurry” to make a peace deal. The ship was struck earlier today in the Gulf and is owned and operated by the Qatar Gas Transport Company. In a statement, GCC Secretary-General Jassim Mohammed al-Budaiwi described the attack on the vessel, operated by Qatar’s Gas Transport Company (Nakilat), as a “dangerous escalation”. He stressed that “maritime security in the Arabian Gulf is a cornerstone of regional stability and the global economy”. Al-Budaiwi warned that targeting gas tankers could disrupt global energy supplies, destabilise markets and damage the marine environment. He also called for those responsible for the “heinous attack” to be held accountable. The GCC reaffirmed its support for Qatar’s measures to safeguard its resources, protect its assets and confront threats to its security and interests.
